newsitem.title: USA: Grand Union to name chairman/CEO - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Grand Union to name chairman/CEO - WSJ.

text.p: Grand Union Co is set to name J. Wayne Harris, the head of A&P Canada Ltd, as its next chairman and chief executive, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Monday's electronic edition, the Journal said that Harris' appointment was expected to be announced later today.

The appointment would end a three-month search for a successor to Joseph McCaig, who resigned as president in early May after the company said he had differences with the board of directors over ways to achieve the supermarket chain's long-term objectives.
Grand Union emerged from bankruptcy-court proceedings in June 1995.

The newspaper said that Chairman Roger Strangeland, who has been serving as interim chief executive while in the wake of McCaig's absence the company has been managed by a four-member office of the chairman, will remain a director and become chairman emeritus.
A&P Canada is a unit of Great Atlantic & Pacific Tea Co Inc.
